column3: Manami Route ・ This Hot Summer
As the end of July came closer, the true face of summer approached.
In this heat, Manami and I were heading somewhere.
Chiba's 8000 Fireworks Display. How many years has it been, since the last time I went to see fireworks?
On top of that, trying to find a good spot to watch them...
Well, that's what a typical "summer date" is all about.
Kyouu-chaan, Wait! Wait!
Oh, am I walking too fast?
You are～. It's difficult to walk that fast in geta sandals!
Sorry, sorry. So, let me hold that for you.
Hmm, it's fine, I can carry it.
It's dangerous if you trip when your hands are full!
I won't trip, so it's fine!
She's holding on to the yakisoba we bought earlier as well as her purse. Is she going to be okay?
It probably would have been better to go for something more comfortable.
Ehhhhhh? The yukata... Doesn't suit me? Boo...
It's not that, it's hard to walk in right?
Hm... a little, yes. Hehehe.
But, I really wanted to wear one!
You do?
I do～ So cute, after all～
...The yukata I mean!
Hahaha, I know.
Geez...!
If that's the case, shouldn't we have just gone to the beach?
What do you mean?
Cause swimsuits are cute too.
T-That's true but...
It was when we talked about where to go this summer.
Of course it had to be the sea, or the pool. And I'm not saying that because of all the hotties in swimsuits!
At that time, Manami's denial was a sight to behold.
Kyou-chan! Fireworks are better!
I didn't think she'd speak up so vehemently. Though I have nothing against fireworks.
B-But I cant! 'Cause... 'Cause you know.
'Cause?
Because I am... plump...
Plump? Ahh, you're talking about your stomach.
Buhh...
Stupid Kyou-chan!
Don't get so angry～!
Fuua. I need to get cuter...
Earlier, I even ate a candy apple... And after Kyou-chan said "Let's do our best"... I still have a long way to go to be the "future" me...
That's not true. You simply have to set a goal for yourself!
*glare*
W-What?
Kyou-chan, I'm going to say something that might be mean, but, what about you?
Ugh...
Yeah, that's true. After we contacted the Tamura household and cleared up the misunderstanding, something else happened.
That is, I too, am aiming to be the "future" Kousaka Kyousuke.
But, as a goal it's so vague I have no clue where to start! Well, I guess that's the same thing Manami's going through.
Ah, Ma-Manami-san! The fireworks are about to start! Don't space out!
Y-You're changing the subject!
Manami! Watch out! Close your eyes!
Eh? Ohe?!
Hah...
Manami, earlier you ate a candy apple right?
Huh, yeah.
You still have some here.
Kyo...Kyou-cha...n
Well then, let's watch the fireworks!
Ky...ou...
G-GEEEEEEEEZZZZ!
Uowaaaa!
Stupid... Kyou-chan!
Heh... angry again.
Y-You're different than earlier. Seriously Kyou-chan...
All of a sudden...
That's... That's...!
That's because you had pieces of candy apple on you.
That has absolutely nothing to do with it!
Doing that... Not doing it suddenly...
What the heck are you talking about?
Bu-... awww... You jerk.
You're getting angry for no reason.
I'm not! W-Why so suddenly, doing something like that... Ki-Ki...Ki...
The candy apple? It stuck right there.
But, Kyou-chan... Well, err... Ki...ss....
I just couldn't ignore it there, sitting on your lips like that.
Well, sure, but... The candy apple, if, if you had just told me...
O-On... The lips... Awwww!
Hey hey, the fireworks just started! If you get yourself worked up so much, you'll miss them!
O-Ohh. That's right...
Okay, look up!
Kyou-chan. If you do something weird again I'll get angry.
Yeah yeah, there's no candy apple pieces left, so you're safe.
Geez!
The fireworks illuminated Manami's profile with a rainbow of colors.
Yeah, it's the face I've seen so many times before. But, seeing it like this... it's been a while.
Manami, isn't she cute? And not just when she's wearing a yukata or having fun at a festival. Maybe I'll tell her this, some time...
